title: Ember and Hollow
author: Odile Blackwood
blurb: Mara Villalobos, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
